content.text: Looking at the data: F3_Z01 (Core_mid) has a weakly seasonal profile (23.9 → 25.1 in 2018), while the perimeter/zone peers show the normal annual cycle. The damper position SP, heating SP, and cooling SP for F3_Z01 all follow the seasonal schedule with no sudden step. The only temperature reading we have for F3_Z01 in 2018 is its own Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor; every other signal in the F3_Z01 stream set (the heating/cooling SPs and the VAV damper SP) is generated by the controller using that same sensor. There is no independent outdoor, load, supply/return, occupancy, or secondary temperature measurement to break the symmetry. So the available streams (zone temp, zone setpoints, damper SP) cannot distinguish a true local load increase from a sensor bias: either hypothesis would manifest as "higher reported temp, more cooling demand".
